about: Luthier v1 (formerly ZenEng v138), fixes 605-609. Kept songs: 159 CoCoPops Billboard songs of 150 sung notes or more. A bar's rhythm is the tuple of its onset positions in twelfths of a beat (0-47); bars are counted by bar number and only sung bars are compared; 'within a section' means both bars carry the same section label with trailing numbers removed (verse with verse).
